hero.headline: 28-Day Kickstart for Busy Schedules
hero.subheadline: Jumpstart your fitness in 28 days – no experience needed, no pressure. All levels welcome.

realResults.title: See Real Results, Fast
realResults.description: Feel fitter and more energetic in 28 days with our proven program. Boost your strength, energy, and confidence.

coaching.title: Personal Coaching & Support
coaching.description: You get guidance from friendly coaches who understand your busy life and keep you motivated and accountable.

flexible.title: Flexible Schedule
flexible.description: Multiple class times and a quick 45-minute format – made for parents and professionals on the go.

habits.title: Habits that Stick
habits.description: Learn proper form, nutrition basics, and workout habits you can sustain beyond the 28 days.

community.title: Community & Fun
community.description: Join a welcoming, non-judgmental community. Exercise becomes enjoyable when you're supported by others like you.

step1.title: Friendly Intro Chat
step1.description: Start your fitness story with a friendly chat and an easy check-in to see where you stand. Free 15-20 minute one-on-one conversation – no workout, just us getting to know your goals.

step2.title: 28-Day Kickstart Program
step2.description: Four weeks of guided training (approx. 3 sessions per week) plus nutrition tips and accountability check-ins. You'll get 12 small-group training sessions, a baseline fitness assessment, and goal review.

step3.title: Your Ongoing Journey
step3.description: After 28 days, you'll have momentum! Graduates of the Kickstart can seamlessly continue into our regular membership, armed with new confidence and habits.

cta.noPressure: No payment or workout required – just a friendly chat!

q1.question: What is a No-Sweat Intro?
q1.answer: A free 15-minute chat – no workout, just talk. Come in work clothes if you want! We'll discuss your goals and answer any questions.

q2.question: I'm really out of shape / over 50 / a beginner – can I do this?
q2.answer: Yes! We specialize in helping beginners of all ages. No judgment, just support. Every workout is scalable to your fitness level.

q3.question: How much time will this take each week?
q3.answer: We recommend 3 sessions per week, each about 45 minutes. That's just over 2 hours per week – designed to fit into busy schedules.

q4.question: What happens after the 28 days?
q4.answer: You can continue with our regular membership or another program. We'll help you find the best path forward based on your goals and progress.
